formula_verified: Iron Condor: Sell OTM call + Buy further OTM call; Sell OTM put + Buy further OTM put. Net credit = (SC−BC) + (SP−BP). Max profit = Net credit. Max loss = Spread width − Net credit (per lot). Breakeven: Upper = short call strike + credit; Lower = short put strike − credit.

calculator_engine: function ironCondor(sc,lc,sp,lp,callCred,putCred,lot){const credit=callCred+putCred;const spreadWidth=Math.max(lc-sc,sc-lp);const maxLoss=(spreadWidth-credit)*lot;const maxProfit=credit*lot;const upperBE=sc+credit;const lowerBE=sp-credit;return{credit,maxProfit,maxLoss,upperBE,lowerBE};}
